title: How many recordable cases a third-party logistics company's twenty ergonomics program DCs will log in fiscal 2027 under an operating plan that works their hours faster against the engineered standards
subdomain: health-burden-impact-modeling (the occupational injury burden of a working population under a planned shift in its exposure: the recordable rate per hour worked as a function of pace against the engineered labor standards, estimated within each DC on person-time, carried to the pace the plan sets)
prompt_shape: one forecast figure to the nearest hundred, two tables for the twenty DCs (fiscal 2026 DART days to 31 October 2026; cases picked over 50 pounds), and a one-slide chart of the five fiscal years' recordable cases beside the forecast

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task149/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional third-party logistics company in Ohio, its distribution centers, its ergonomics vendor and their systems; no real organisation, person or system is depicted. Form layouts follow 29 CFR Part 1904 and OSHA's Injury Tracking Application field names; event codes follow BLS OIICS 2.01.
